rejectionPatterns.description: Entry describes internal deliberation or administrative work (approving a draft letter, working through discovery-tracker data) between Chris and a colleague/outside counsel, with no new case development or communication from an external party (opposing counsel, court, claimant).
examples: Chris approved outside counsel's (Greenberg Traurig) draft deficiency letter for the JAMS driver-partner arbitrations, to be sent ahead of the arbitrator and claimant.

Chris and Seth Taylor worked through the discovery-tracker response for time-tracking metric definitions (queued/delivering/scheduled/returning hours); Seth added narrative notes in place of a formal data dictionary.
